Belonging to the genre of edifying biographical poems recounting the previous lives and karmic fruitions of the early monastic disciples, the text presents the story of an elder who offered a jackfruit (*panasaphala*) to a holy personage, resulting in auspicious rebirths and eventual liberation [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of this work across five languages [SuttaCentral].
